title: Electrical Engineer
description:
Who We Are:

Aurelius Systems is a VC backed defense tech startup building autonomous, edge deployed directed energy systems for counter-UAS. We build laser weapons to shoot down drones.

We're a small team of engineers, former US military operators, and subject matter experts scaling America's directed energy dominance. The first cost effective, reliable and robust laser weapon system.

Our namesake isn't an accident. Marcus Aurelius wrote about doing the work in front of you, every day, without excuses. Henry Ford didn't wait for permission to reinvent manufacturing. That's how we operate - small team, unreasonable output, no hiding behind the unachievable.

In addition to our San Francisco lab, we’ve opened a Detroit manufacturing hub and we field test weekly on our own 400-acre private range.

The Role & Your Impact:

We need an Electrical Engineer who can own a wide surface area of electromechanical hardware. You won't specialize in one subsystem, you'll move across power, embedded control, wire harnesses, and integration work, wherever the team needs horsepower. That means you're soldering prototypes one day, pulling harnesses the next, and helping integrate subsystems on the range the week after.

This isn't a narrow role. It's a force multiplier position on a small team building a weapon system from scratch.

What You'll Own:

- Design and build high-voltage DC/DC converters, rectifiers, inverters, and diode driver electronics (48V+ systems)

- Architect and validate battery management systems from safe charge/discharge, thermal management, to fault protection for high-voltage battery packs

- Build ruggedized wire harnesses for high-power laser and motor systems (connector selection, routing, environmental protection)

- Drive hands-on prototyping, assembly, and field testing of power electronic systems on our range

- Design embedded control electronics like microcontrollers, FPGAs, sensing, telemetry, and fault handling

- Perform electrical simulations (SPICE, MATLAB/Simulink) to optimize performance before you build

- Conduct DFM reviews and work directly with fabricators to get designs into production

- Integrate electronics with mechanical, optical, and robotics subsystems

- Generate schematics, BOMs, wiring diagrams, and documentation meeting MIL-STD and ITAR requirements

What We're Looking For:

- 2-5+ years working across electrical hardware from power, embedded, to systems integration

- Hands-on experience with 48V+ systems. You've built and tested high-voltage circuits, not just reviewed drawings

- Comfortable with embedded control electronics like microcontrollers, sensing, telemetry, and fault handling

- You've designed and fabricated wire harnesses for real systems

- Multi-layer PCB design, IC selection, and on-board thermal management

- Proficient in Altium Designer, SPICE, and MATLAB/Simulink

- Broad curiosity. You're as comfortable debugging a harness as reading a power schematic

Where you probably come from: Robotics labs, EV companies, aerospace hardware teams, defense programs, or Formula SAE Electric. You don't have to be a power specialist, but you need to have built real things at voltage.

Not a fit if: Your experience is exclusively low-voltage microcontroller or PCB work, or you've never physically built and tested hardware above 48V.

Nice-to-Haves:

- Experience with laser diode driving or directed energy power systems

- Background in EMI/EMC design and shielding

- Familiarity with MIL-STD standards and ITAR compliance

- Experience with long-duration system deployment in harsh environments

- Active security clearance or ability to obtain one

Education:

BS or MS in Electrical Engineering, Power Electronics, or related field.

What you've built matters more than where you went to school.

How You Operate:

- Extreme bias for action. You'd rather build a prototype tomorrow than model it for a month

- Rigorous testing mindset. You characterize your own systems before the field

title: Chief of Staff
description:
ABOUT US

Featherless AI is a 3-year-old, venture-backed AI inference company ($27M raised); we’re building the inference stack for specialized intelligence. We're a team of ~40 people moving fast - and we need someone to help our CEO and leadership team move faster, with less breakage.

ABOUT THE ROLE

We're hiring our first Chief of Staff to unlock our next phase of growth.

Too much context lives in founder's heads. Roles and responsibilities are unclear, key projects lack singular owners / DRI and prioritization is always a challenge. Defining clear KPIs with owners and beating a drum around accountability is a key missing piece that needs an owner. This is the heart of the Chief of Staff role.

This role exists to fix that. You'll convert founder instinct into process - without turning a 40-person company into a bureaucracy. This is not an executive-assistant role, and it's not an "AI adoption lead". You'll have real ownership over operational areas, not just support the CEO's calendar.

We're early enough that this role will be defined significantly by what you're good at. We're looking for someone who's comfortable with that trade.

WHAT YOU'LL OWN

- Operational admin that shouldn't sit with the CEO - vendor contracts and renewals, finance/ops logistics, and recruiting-process management (not sourcing, but the machinery: pipeline tracking, interview loops, offer logistics).

- Cross-team coordination - you'll be the connective tissue between engineering, sales, and product when priorities drift out of alignment. You notice when teams aren't talking to each other before it becomes a fire.

- The operating rhythm - as the company grows past 50, you'll help stand up the cadence (leadership meetings, action-item tracking, decision follow-through) that keeps priorities from living only in discord threads and the founder's memory.

- Special projects - whatever is highest-priority and doesn't have a clear owner yet. This will shift month to month.

WHAT YOU'LL NEED

- 5+ years in a high-ownership, fast-moving environment (startup operations, strategy consulting, banking, or similar) - strong judgment under ambiguity matters more than a specific pedigree.

- Enough technical fluency to sit in engineering syncs and customer calls and follow what's being discussed. You don't need to have built ML systems, but you should be comfortable enough with how inference/model-serving products work to ask good questions and not need everything translated for you.

- A track record of turning messy, undefined problems into a plan and driving it to done - with minimal hand-holding.

- Strong written and verbal communication; you'll be relied on to represent the CEO's intent accurately in rooms the CEO isn't in.

- Comfort with the fact that this role will change shape as the company scales. Some Chiefs of Staff grow into a functional VP role (Ops, BizOps, etc.); others stay in a generalist seat. We genuinely don't know yet which this will be - it depends on you and on where the company's needs go.

description:
Why We Exist
Your car and your home are your most important assets, yet the experience of owning them is stuck in the 90s. Every part of the journey - insurance, repairs, financing, maintenance - is fragmented, complicated, and expensive. Jerry is building the first app to manage it all.
We started with car insurance in 2019, became one of the top three brokers in the country, then added driving insights, diagnostics, and a repair marketplace. We've reached 5M+ customers, raised $240M+, scaled revenue 70X, and became profitable in early 2024.
Why We're Hiring
The next frontier is helping people with the cost of owning a home. Property tax appeals is one of the first offerings we're building - and the Florida appeals season is starting.
This is a domain where being 90% right isn’t going to cut it. Florida's Value Adjustment Board process has a 25-day filing window, a partial-payment requirement that silently kills otherwise-valid petitions, and 67 counties that each run the process differently. Before a single homeowner's petition depends on what we build, we need someone who has lived inside that system to pressure-test it.
This is a deliberately narrow engagement - a few hours a week from someone excellent. The work is advisory: reviewing what we build, flagging what won't survive contact with the VAB, and telling us when we're wrong before it costs a customer.
Why You Will (Or Won't) Like Working Here

• Hourly, as-needed : This is an independent contractor engagement at roughly 5-10 hours per week with no fixed schedule. If this product starts to see traction, there is a path to a full-time permanent role if you’re interested.

• Early-stage product : You are advising on a new product. The customer flows, backend authorization flows, and filing logic is still being shaped. Your job is to help guide our design and help correct things before we push it to production.

What You'll Own

• Regulatory grounding : Clarify how things like Chapter 194, F.S. and the DOR uniform rules (12D-9, 12D-10) operate in practice and not only how they read on paper.

• County-level reality : Walk us through how the Property Appraiser's offices and VABs actually differ across the volume counties: Miami-Dade, Broward, Palm Beach, Hillsborough, Orange, Duval, Pinellas, and Lee.

• Filing mechanics : TRIM notice timing, the 25-day window, DR-486 and its variants, e-filing versus paper, and the §194.014 partial-payment requirement - guide us through the process.

• Hearings and evidence : Help build a flow that actually wins in front of a special magistrate - comparable selection, the 15-day and 7-day evidence exchange windows, and condition-based arguments.

Who You Are

• Built inside the VAB system : You can describe why Broward is different from Hillsborough without looking it up. Your knowledge was built through filings or arguing petitions, not advising on property tax from a distance.

• Volume-tested : You've worked across hundreds of parcels and seen enough edge cases that you recognize the pattern before it becomes a problem.

• Procedurally sharp : You know every step of the appeals process as if it was the back of your hand.

What You'll Bring

• 5+ years of direct, hands-on Florida experience filing residential property tax appeals.

• Personal experience filing or arguing petitions before a Florida VAB, or adjudicating them as a special magistrate.

• No active conflict: not currently advising another company building consumer property tax appeal software.

• Florida-based strongly preferred, given county-level familiarity requirements.

ABOUT MIDDESK:

Middesk is building the data and intelligence infrastructure that helps businesses work together with confidence. We started by creating a comprehensive platform for understanding businesses, bringing together authoritative and proprietary data to help customers verify business identities, onboard customers faster, and manage risk throughout the customer lifecycle.

Today, Middesk is used by more than 700 banks and fintechs, and in 2025 we verified more than 7 million companies. We've also expanded beyond business verification to help companies form, register, manage, and maintain their businesses, supporting more than 50,000 companies in setting up over 100,000 accounts required to hire employees, run payroll, and stay compliant.

Middesk came out of Y Combinator, and is backed by Sequoia Capital, Accel, Insight Partners, and Canapi. We're proud to be named on the Forbes Fintech 50 and Best Startup Employers lists.

THE ROLE:

We’re hiring a Manager, Product Operations to lead a critical part of the operational infrastructure behind Middesk’s products reporting to our Head of Product.

Middesk operates products that turn complicated, fragmented real-world processes into simple customer experiences. Behind those experiences is significant operational complexity. Registering a company for payroll taxes may require navigating different requirements, systems, and government agencies across all 50 states. Business formations introduce another set of jurisdiction-specific workflows. Across our Business Verification and Credit products, complex cases, data issues, and exceptions require careful investigation and judgment.

Our Product Operations teams sit at the center of that complexity. They help ensure our products deliver accurate, reliable outcomes for customers, own the workflows required when automation cannot complete the job, investigate complex cases and product issues, manage quality and remediation programs, and turn what they learn from operating the product into better processes and better products.

This role will initially lead our Entity Operations team, a team of approximately 5-7 people supporting our Payroll Tax and emerging Business Formations products, with the opportunity to expand over time to oversee Product Operations across Middesk more broadly.

You will be responsible for building an operation that can scale alongside the products it supports. That means developing the team, establishing strong operating rhythms and quality programs, improving measurement and visibility into product health, managing our BPO partners, and systematically reducing unnecessary manual work through better processes, tooling, automation, and AI.

Just as importantly, this is not a team that simply executes processes handed to it. Product Operations is an important feedback loop into the product itself. You and your team will develop deep expertise in government requirements and operational edge cases, identify where workflows break down, and work closely with Product and Engineering to turn that knowledge into more reliable and scalable systems.

WHAT YOU'LL DO:

- Lead and develop a high-performing operations team. Set clear expectations, coach team members, and build strong operating rhythms.

- Own the operational health of our Entity Management products. Ensure Payroll Tax Registration, Business Formations, and adjacent products deliver accurate, timely, and reliable outcomes.

- Make operations more efficient. Improve processes, tooling, automation, and AI-enabled workflows to reduce manual work while preserving appropriate human judgment.

- Turn operational knowledge into better products. Partner closely with Product and Engineering
